---
title: "UpSet plots and directional ASV sharing — by coral type and health state"
author: "Joana Krause"
date: "2025-12-16"
output: html_document
---

UpSet plots of ASV sharing across coral health conditions (within each coral type)
and across coral types (within healthy corals). Each section also computes a
directional sharing matrix: for every reference group, the percentage of its ASVs
that are unique, shared pairwise, or shared with two or more other groups.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
```

# Load libraries

```{r load-libraries, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(phyloseq)
library(UpSetR)
library(purrr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
```

# Define helper function

```{r define-helpers}
## directional_percent()
##
## For a given 'target' group, compute what percentage of its ASVs fall into
## each directional intersection category:
##   - "specific"       : exclusive to the target, absent from all others
##   - "<group>"        : shared with exactly one other group
##   - "<g1> & <g2>"   : shared with exactly two other groups
##   - etc.
##
## Arguments:
##   target   – name of the reference group (character)
##   include  – names of groups to include in the intersection (character vector,
##              length 0 means "specific")
##   ASV_list – named list of character vectors, one per group

directional_percent <- function(target, include, ASV_list) {

  target_asvs <- ASV_list[[target]]

  # ASVs shared between target and every group in 'include'
  if (length(include) == 0) {
    intersect_asvs <- target_asvs
  } else {
    intersect_asvs <- Reduce(intersect, ASV_list[c(target, include)])
  }

  # Remove ASVs that also appear in any group outside target + include
  exclude <- setdiff(names(ASV_list), c(target, include))
  if (length(exclude) > 0) {
    intersect_asvs <- setdiff(intersect_asvs, Reduce(union, ASV_list[exclude]))
  }

  n_intersection <- length(intersect_asvs)
  n_total        <- length(target_asvs)

  data.frame(
    target       = target,
    intersection = ifelse(length(include) == 0, "specific",
                          paste(include, collapse = " & ")),
    count        = n_intersection,
    total        = n_total,
    percent      = round(100 * n_intersection / n_total, 2)
  )
}
```

# Load phyloseq object

```{r load-ps}
ps_plas_V3_V4 <- readRDS("../data/ps_final.rds")

dir.create("../output/upset", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# COMPLEXA — ASV sharing across health states
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r complexa-upset}
# ── 1. Subset and extract tables ──────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_complexa <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                              ps_plas_V3_V4@sam_data$complexa_robusta == "complexa")

otu_table     <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_complexa))
metadata_table <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_complexa))

health_condition <- unique(ps_complexa@sam_data$coral_health)

# ── 2. Build ASV presence list per health condition ───────────────────────────
ASV_list <- lapply(health_condition, function(health) {
  coral_status <- rownames(metadata_table[metadata_table$coral_health == health, ])
  otu_subset   <- otu_table[, coral_status, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(otu_subset[rowSums(otu_subset[, coral_status] > 0) > 0, ])
})
names(ASV_list) <- health_condition

set_names <- c("bleached", "disease", "healthy")

# ── 3. UpSet plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
upset_plot <- UpSetR::upset(fromList(ASV_list),
                            sets           = set_names,
                            sets.bar.color = c("#eed2ccff", "#ad6a6cff", "#6c9a8bff"),
                            order.by       = "freq",
                            keep.order     = TRUE,
                            mainbar.y.label = "ASV Intersection Size",
                            text.scale      = 3)
print(upset_plot)

pdf("../output/upset/upset_plot_complexa.pdf", width = 9, height = 10)
upset_plot
dev.off()

# ── 4. Directional sharing (Part II) ──────────────────────────────────────────
set_sizes <- sapply(ASV_list, length)
print(set_sizes)

groups <- names(ASV_list)

all_results <- map_df(groups, function(target) {
  others <- setdiff(groups, target)
  bind_rows(
    directional_percent(target, character(0), ASV_list),
    map_df(others, ~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list)),
    map_df(2:length(others), function(k) {
      combn(others, k, simplify = FALSE) %>%
        map_df(~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list))
    })
  )
})

print(all_results)

write.csv(all_results,
          "../output/upset/ASV_directional_sharing_complexa.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── 5. Sharing matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pairwise <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection != "specific", !grepl("&", intersection))

sharing_matrix <- pairwise %>%
  mutate(compared = intersection) %>%
  select(target, compared, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compared, values_from = percent, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("target") %>%
  as.matrix()

sharing_matrix <- sharing_matrix[groups, groups]

specific_vec <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection == "specific") %>%
  select(target, percent) %>% deframe()

diag(sharing_matrix) <- specific_vec[groups]
print(sharing_matrix)

# ── 6. Heatmap of sharing percentages ────────────────────────────────────────
sharing_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(sharing_matrix))
colnames(sharing_df) <- c("From", "To", "Percent")

heatmap_fig <- ggplot(sharing_df, aes(To, From, fill = Percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Percent, 1), color = Percent > 55), size = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 100),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal",
                                             title.position = "top",
                                             barwidth = 10, barheight = 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Shared with", y = "Reference group", fill = "% ASVs",
       caption = "Diagonal values = % ASVs specific to each group")

ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_complexa.pdf", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_complexa.png", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# OCTOCORAL — ASV sharing across health states
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r octocoral-upset}
# ── 1. Subset ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_octocoral <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                               ps_plas_V3_V4@sam_data$complexa_robusta == "octocoral")

otu_table      <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_octocoral))
metadata_table <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_octocoral))

health_condition <- unique(ps_octocoral@sam_data$coral_health)

# ── 2. ASV list ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
ASV_list <- lapply(health_condition, function(health) {
  coral_status <- rownames(metadata_table[metadata_table$coral_health == health, ])
  otu_subset   <- otu_table[, coral_status, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(otu_subset[rowSums(otu_subset[, coral_status] > 0) > 0, ])
})
names(ASV_list) <- health_condition

# NOTE: no bleached samples in octocoral
set_names <- c("disease", "healthy")

# ── 3. UpSet plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
upset_plot <- UpSetR::upset(fromList(ASV_list),
                            sets           = set_names,
                            sets.bar.color = c("#ad6a6cff", "#6c9a8bff"),
                            order.by       = "freq",
                            keep.order     = TRUE,
                            mainbar.y.label = "ASV Intersection Size",
                            text.scale      = 3)
print(upset_plot)

pdf("../output/upset/upset_plot_octocoral.pdf", width = 6, height = 10)
upset_plot
dev.off()

# ── 4. Directional sharing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set_sizes <- sapply(ASV_list, length)
print(set_sizes)

groups <- names(ASV_list)

all_results <- map_df(groups, function(target) {
  others <- setdiff(groups, target)
  bind_rows(
    directional_percent(target, character(0), ASV_list),
    map_df(others, ~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list)),
    # Only run combinations if ≥2 others (guards against empty map_df)
    if (length(others) >= 2) {
      map_df(2:length(others), function(k) {
        combn(others, k, simplify = FALSE) %>%
          map_df(~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list))
      })
    }
  )
})

print(all_results)

write.csv(all_results,
          "../output/upset/ASV_directional_sharing_octocoral.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── 5. Sharing matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pairwise <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection != "specific", !grepl("&", intersection))

sharing_matrix <- pairwise %>%
  mutate(compared = intersection) %>%
  select(target, compared, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compared, values_from = percent, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("target") %>%
  as.matrix()

sharing_matrix <- sharing_matrix[groups, groups]

specific_vec <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection == "specific") %>%
  select(target, percent) %>% deframe()

diag(sharing_matrix) <- specific_vec[groups]
print(sharing_matrix)

# ── 6. Heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sharing_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(sharing_matrix))
colnames(sharing_df) <- c("From", "To", "Percent")

heatmap_fig <- ggplot(sharing_df, aes(To, From, fill = Percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Percent, 1), color = Percent > 55), size = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 100),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal",
                                             title.position = "top",
                                             barwidth = 10, barheight = 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Shared with", y = "Reference group", fill = "% ASVs",
       caption = "Diagonal values = % ASVs specific to each group")

ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_octocoral.pdf", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_octocoral.png", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# HEALTHY — ASV sharing across coral types
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

```{r healthy-upset}
# ── 1. Subset to healthy samples ──────────────────────────────────────────────
ps_healthy <- subset_samples(ps_plas_V3_V4,
                             ps_plas_V3_V4@sam_data$coral_health == "healthy")

otu_table      <- as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_healthy))
metadata_table <- as.data.frame(sample_data(ps_healthy))

coral_type <- unique(ps_healthy@sam_data$complexa_robusta)

# ── 2. ASV list per coral type ────────────────────────────────────────────────
ASV_list <- lapply(coral_type, function(k) {
  sample_ids <- rownames(metadata_table[metadata_table$complexa_robusta == k, ])
  otu_subset <- otu_table[, sample_ids, drop = FALSE]
  rownames(otu_subset[rowSums(otu_subset > 0) > 0, ])
})
coral_type_clean <- make.names(coral_type)   # "black coral" → "black.coral"
names(ASV_list)  <- coral_type_clean

set_names <- c("octocoral", "black.coral", "robusta", "complexa")

# ── 3. UpSet plot ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
upset_plot <- UpSetR::upset(fromList(ASV_list),
                            sets            = set_names,
                            sets.bar.color  = c("darkgoldenrod1", "gray32",
                                                "darkolivegreen3", "darkmagenta"),
                            order.by        = "freq",
                            keep.order      = TRUE,
                            mainbar.y.label = "ASV Intersection Size",
                            text.scale      = c(3))
print(upset_plot)

pdf("../output/upset/upset_plot_healthy.pdf", width = 14, height = 8)
upset_plot
dev.off()

# ── 4. Directional sharing ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
set_sizes <- sapply(ASV_list, length)
print(set_sizes)

groups <- names(ASV_list)

all_results <- map_df(groups, function(target) {
  others <- setdiff(groups, target)
  bind_rows(
    directional_percent(target, character(0), ASV_list),
    map_df(others, ~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list)),
    map_df(2:length(others), function(k) {
      combn(others, k, simplify = FALSE) %>%
        map_df(~ directional_percent(target, .x, ASV_list))
    })
  )
})

print(all_results)

# BUG FIX: original script wrote to "ASV_directional_sharing_complexa.csv"
# (same as the COMPLEXA section). Correct filename: ASV_directional_sharing_healthy.csv
write.csv(all_results,
          "../output/upset/ASV_directional_sharing_healthy.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── 5. Sharing matrix ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
pairwise <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection != "specific", !grepl("&", intersection))

sharing_matrix <- pairwise %>%
  mutate(compared = intersection) %>%
  select(target, compared, percent) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = compared, values_from = percent, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("target") %>%
  as.matrix()

sharing_matrix <- sharing_matrix[groups, groups]

specific_vec <- all_results %>%
  filter(intersection == "specific") %>%
  select(target, percent) %>% deframe()

diag(sharing_matrix) <- specific_vec[groups]
print(sharing_matrix)

# ── 6. Heatmap ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
sharing_df <- as.data.frame(as.table(sharing_matrix))
colnames(sharing_df) <- c("From", "To", "Percent")

heatmap_fig <- ggplot(sharing_df, aes(To, From, fill = Percent)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(Percent, 1), color = Percent > 55), size = 5.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "#FFFFFF", high = "steelblue", limits = c(0, 100),
                      guide = guide_colorbar(direction = "horizontal",
                                             title.position = "top",
                                             barwidth = 10, barheight = 0.8)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "black", "FALSE" = "black"), guide = "none") +
  coord_equal() + theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(x = "Shared with", y = "Reference group", fill = "% ASVs",
       caption = "Diagonal values = % ASVs specific to each group")

ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_healthy.pdf", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in")
ggsave("../output/upset/heatmap_healthy.png", heatmap_fig,
       width = 6, height = 5, units = "in", dpi = 300)
```

# text.scale reference — UpSetR argument documentation

```{r text-scale-reference}
# text.scale can be a scalar (applied to all text elements) or a vector of 6:
#
# text.scale = c(
#   2,  # Intersection size numbers (main bar plot y-axis numbers)
#   2,  # Set size numbers (left bar plot)
#   2,  # Set names (bottom labels)
#   2,  # Main bar plot axis title
#   2,  # Left bar plot axis title
#   2   # Titles (e.g., "ASV Intersection Size")
# )
```
